paite: Aigupta gam a hong lut Israel suante, michih leh a-inkote Jakob toh hong tonte min hiaite ahi:
heading: Israelte Aigupta Ah Hihgentheih In A-om Uh
english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):

paite: Reuben, Simeon, Levi leh Judah,
english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

paite: Issakar, Zebulun leh Benjamin,
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

paite: Dan leh Naphtali, Gad leh Asher,
english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

paite: Jakob khal a pan hong pawtkhia mi tengteng sawmsagih ahi uhi. Joseph bel Aigupta gam ah ana om khinta hi.
english: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.

paite: Joseph leh a-unau tengteng leh asuan tengteng leng asita uhi.
english: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.

paite: Israel suante'n gah asuang ua, tampi in akhang ua, ahong kibehlap zel ua, hat petmah in ahong hatkhia ua; agam hong dimta uhi.
english: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.

paite: Joseph thei lou, Aigupta gam ah kumpi thak ahong omta hi.
english: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.

paite: Ama'n amite kiang ah, "En un, Israel suante ei sang in atamzaw ua, ahatzaw uhi.
english: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.

paite: Kisa un, piltak in amaute i bawl ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw ahong kibehlap semsem ding ua, huan, hichi ahong hi ding a, kidouna ahong om chiang in, i melmate lam ah apang ding ua, ei ahon dou kha ding uh, huchi in gam apawtsan kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”

paite: Huaiziak in puakgikte a amau hihgim ding in atung uah nasem heutu akoihta uhi. Huchi in Pharaoh a ding in khopite, Pithom leh Rameses alamta uhi.
english: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.

paite: Himahleh amau ahihgim semsem uleh, akibehlap semsem ua, akhang semsem uhi. Huchi in Aiguptate'n Israel suante alau mahmah uhi.
english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in Aiguptate'n Israel suante gimtak in nna asemsak uhi.
english: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,

paite: Nasep haksa in ahinna uh nuamloutak in abawlsak ua, buanman leh teklei bawl in gamlak a nna chiteng sem in, nakpitak in nna asemsak uhi.
english: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n Hebru naudom mite kiang ah thu agen a, huaite lak a khat min Siprah ahi a, adang khat min Puah ahi.
english: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,

paite: "Hebru numeite lak a nau na dop chiang un, tutphah tung ah en unla, tapa ahihleh na that ding ua, tanu ahihleh bel na hawi ding uh,” achi hi.
english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”

paite: Himahleh naudom mite'n Pathian alau ua, Aigupta kumpipa'n thu apiak bang a hih lou in, pasal naupangte ahinghawi uhi.
english: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n naudom mite asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hiai thilhih a pasal naupangte hinghawi na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”

paite: Naudom mite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hebru numeite zaw Aigupta numeite bang ahih louh ziak un, atei ngal ua, naudom mite akiang uh atun ma un ana nei khin man zel uh," achi uhi.
english: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in naudom mite a-angvan a, huchi in mite ahong kibehlap ua, ahat mahmah uhi.
english: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.

paite: Huchi in naudom mite'n Pathian alauh ziak un inkuante abawlsakta hi.
english: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.

paite: Pharaoh in asikha tengteng thu pia in, "Tapa hong piang peuhmah lui ah na pai ding ua, tanu hong piang peuhmah na hinghawi ding uh," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
